tagline: LET US PLAY YOUR MARKETING GAME.
visual_direction: Dark Editorial × Technical Interface × Creative Studio × Game System

hierarchy.h2_section: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl uppercase font-bold tracking-tight font-display

key_features_and_sections.name: 01 Preloader Sequence
key_features_and_sections.description: Interactive intro loader with animated CLAW MEDIA vector mark, retro system boot readout, 'LOADING THE GAME...' percentage bar, target reticle animation, and 'READY? - PRESS START' trigger button

key_features_and_sections.name: 02 Technical Command Navbar
key_features_and_sections.description: Minimal top bar with live server status dot (ONLINE), FPS/latency micro readout, section jump anchors, and 'PLAY WITH US' primary cyan CTA button

key_features_and_sections.name: 03 Game Operating Hero
key_features_and_sections.description: Huge display headline 'LET US PLAY YOUR MARKETING GAME.' featuring an interactive hanging physical swinging board 'CLAW STUDIO' under the 'G' in MARKETING that subtle-swings on hover/scroll. Includes 'Technology × Media × Marketing' tag, 'START THE GAME' CTA, and floating live UI cards (Leads +197/mo, ROI 4.8x, Live System Alerts)

key_features_and_sections.name: 04 What's Your Game?
key_features_and_sections.description: 7 selectable industry cards (Real Estate, Hospitality, Café & Nightlife, Jewellery, Education, Coaching, Study Abroad). Selecting an industry activates a step-by-step interactive marketing funnel (e.g. Website → Leads → CRM → Content → Ads → Conversion) with metric benchmarks

key_features_and_sections.name: 05 Things We Do
key_features_and_sections.description: Services organized into 4 core game systems: BUILD (Web & Engines), CREATE (Media & Studio), GROW (Traffic & Ads), AUTOMATE (CRM & AI Agents) with detailed sub-skill tags

key_features_and_sections.name: 06 360° System Interface
key_features_and_sections.description: 'ONE BUSINESS. ONE SYSTEM.' interactive radial hub diagram connecting BRAND, MEDIA, TRAFFIC, TECH, DATA, CRM, and AUTOMATION into a central pulsing GROWTH engine

key_features_and_sections.name: 07 How We Play Process
key_features_and_sections.description: 5-Level progression roadmap (LEVEL 01 UNDERSTAND → LEVEL 02 BUILD → LEVEL 03 LAUNCH → LEVEL 04 OPTIMIZE → LEVEL 05 SCALE) with XP metrics and milestone deliverables

key_features_and_sections.name: 08 The Games We've Played
key_features_and_sections.description: High-impact case study cards with real data: KINGS PRIDE INFRA (+197 leads, ₹40.72 CPL), SHONITARA (D2C Jewellery growth), SBJ (Jewellery brand transformation)

key_features_and_sections.name: 09 Play With CLAW - Website Score Analyzer
key_features_and_sections.description: Working interactive tool where users enter their URL, receive an instant CLAW SCORE breakdown (Brand, Experience, Mobile, Conversion, SEO, Performance, Social, Growth Potential), 'YOUR BIGGEST OPPORTUNITY' analysis, and a lead capture form to request full strategy PDF

key_features_and_sections.name: 10 The CLAW Lab
key_features_and_sections.description: Experimental tech cards showcase (AI Marketing Agents, Next-Gen Web Experiences, Campaign Experiments, Creator Systems, Marketing Automation, Data Intelligence)

key_features_and_sections.name: 11 Why The CLAW?
key_features_and_sections.description: 4 brutal truth statements countering traditional agency failures with high-contrast editorial typography

key_features_and_sections.name: 12 Ready To Play Enquiry Engine
key_features_and_sections.description: Final conversion section with 'START A PROJECT' / 'JUST SAY HELLO' tabs, quick WhatsApp link, and a comprehensive project enquiry form

key_features_and_sections.name: 13 Technical Command Footer
key_features_and_sections.description: Footer with system coordinates, social links, status monitors, and copyright © 2026 CLAW MEDIA

visual_enhancers.cursor: Custom reticle target crosshair with smooth tracking and hover state expander
visual_enhancers.background_effects: Interactive Canvas particle grid + WebGL pulse lines + dark vignette border + scanlines overlay
visual_enhancers.hanging_sign: CSS keyframe swing animation with physical spring stiffness on the CLAW STUDIO hanging sign in hero
visual_enhancers.micro_decorations: Technical corner crosshairs (+), grid alignment lines, handwritten technical notes, data labels in monospace

instructions_to_main_agent: Import Anton, Hanken Grotesk, and JetBrains Mono Google Fonts in index.html / index.css
Ensure seamless single-page flow across all 13 sections without boxy isolated gaps
Implement the physical swinging CLAW STUDIO hanging sign under the 'G' in MARKETING in the hero
Provide full interactive functionality for the Website Score Tool with calculated score cards and lead capture modal
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, and industry cards
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
